event_section.hydrographic_context: Bevano tributary within the Burano-Candigliano system

network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto pubblica idrogrammi sul sistema Burano-Candigliano, incluso Pontedazzo a valle di Cantiano, ma non una sezione sul torrente Bevano compatibile con il ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The report publishes hydrographs for the Burano-Candigliano system, including Pontedazzo downstream of Cantiano, but no Bevano gauge section compatible with the bridge.

sources.title: Rapporto di evento: maltempo 15, 16 e 17 settembre 2022

curation_note.it: Pontedazzo misura il Burano dopo l'apporto dei tributari di Cantiano: il suo idrogramma documenta la piena del sistema, ma non viene assegnato al ponte sul Bevano.
curation_note.en: Pontedazzo gauges the Burano after inflows from Cantiano tributaries: its hydrograph documents the system flood but is not assigned to the Bevano bridge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official regional event report

caveats: The official hydrographs are published for different sections of the Burano-Candigliano system.
No stage, discharge or hydrograph is assigned to the Bevano bridge section.
The report graph is not manually digitised into a false-precision numeric peak.
Basin processes do not by themselves prove the bridge-collapse mechanism.
